text:
alex: quick heads up — running the node sampleapp against /embeddings and /rerank. REST v.s. SDK parity oddness: REST call returns a flat array of length 1536, node-sdk returns an extra trailing null in the vector so shape looks like 1537. also seeing duplicate vectors when the token expires mid-batch (401 -> retry double-send).

monica: ugh. can you paste the request + minimal log? which sdk version?

alex: using node sdk v0.8.1 locally. request:
```js
const r = await Redwood.embeddings.create({
  model: 'open-embed-1536',
  input: batch,
  batchingHelper: { maxBatchSize: 32 }
});
```
log snippet: `embedding[0].length = 1537` and then after retry `sentChunks = 2` with identical ids.

jordan: hmm batching helper should only chunk arrays, not mutate vectors. do you have a sample that reproduces?

alex: pasted gist: https://gist.github.com/anon/abcd1234 — steps: 1) long inputs to force 2 chunks, 2) short lived token (10s TTL via local test), 3) observe 401 on chunk 1, sdk auto-retries chunk 1 and chunk 2 ends up duplicated. also the vector extra value is `null` at the end.

sarah: sounds like two separate bugs: (A) response shape difference (null appended) and (B) retry semantics causing duplicate sends after auth failure.

monica: could be response-formatting change in node layer where we do `response.vector.push(metadata)` for tracing. we had an old helper that appended a scalar for quality.

jordan: that rings a bell — we added a `metaPad` flag in an early PR (forgot to gate it) to pack a tiny float for offline quality scoring. python sdk strips it. node left it on by default.

alex: so parity bug + retry bug. any quick mitigations for customers?

sarah: short term: set `batchingHelper: { preserveVectorShape: true }` if using the node helper (this will disable padding) and bump retry auth logic: set `retryOnAuth: false` in client config to avoid silent re-sends while we patch.

monica: I'll add a note to sampleapp README and publish a patch sample with explicit headers. Also add a snippet: `client.setAuthStrategy({ refreshOn401: true, singleRetry: true })` — ensures we refresh token then re-run the whole request once.

alex: confirmed local workaround fixed the extra null. duplicate send still reproducible until I flip singleRetry. thanks.

jordan: opened PR to fix parity and to add a test for vector length: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/1319 — patch unsets metaPad by default and updates the batching helper contract.

deploy-bot: PR 1319 pushed to canary, build started.

ci-bot: canary build failed on lint (`no-console` in sampleapp).

monica: fixing lint, will force-push.

ci-bot: canary build passed. integration tests: embeddings shape check ✅, retry-behavior test added.

alex: verified canary, sampleapp now returns exact 1536 floats and retry does not duplicate. thanks y'all :thumbsup:

monica: I'll land docs update and add an FAQ entry about `preserveVectorShape` and auth guidance. tagging support to pre-empt customer tickets. @support-team please scan recent support threads for duplicates.

sarah: follow-up: create a small test in onboarding CI that runs sampleapp against a mock short-lived-token scenario to catch regressions. I'll add it to the test matrix.

alex: sounds good. file a follow-up ticket for a single SDK-wide `retryPolicy` that understands idempotency across chunking.

jordan: added ticket INF-2043.

monica: closing the loop here. thanks — will send out a short blurb on the next dev-ex digest.
